title: Hold focus inside confirmOverlay and promptOverlay so Shift+Tab cannot leave them
notes:
confirmOverlay and promptOverlay in src/renderer/app/overlay.ts hold no focus: Shift+Tab is a modified key, so answerKeys lets it through, and focus moves to the last focusable element before the overlay (a prompt box or a pane) while the sheet stays up. An Escape meant to cancel the dialog then reaches the page behind it. Fix with a shared focus hold in overlay.ts, as viewerOverlay does with its focusin listener; no key handling changes, so keys-rule-1 is untouched.

Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/182
Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/180#discussion_r4438105899

comments.body: Tracks issue #182 (https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/182). confirmOverlay and promptOverlay still do not call holdFocus on main as of ad100b60.
